maria_pm: FYI — Jordan just flagged a private/on‑prem intake from Kumu Labs. They want an air-gapped deployment + HSM for keys. Timeline: customer asks for go‑live in ~12 weeks. Can we triage?
jordan_sales: Kumu Labs — conversion risk if we miss timeline. They're evaluating Dedicated and on‑prem. Big ask: encrypted model weights at rest + customer‑managed KMS. Also want SAML SSO and 1yr audit logs.
vivian_se: tagging in. Quick Qs: do they need full on‑prem (no outbound) or VPC with peering to our control plane? Jordan: customer said "no outbound egress allowed" except updates via customer ops.
maria_pm: OK that's air‑gapped. High level: we should capture feasibility, non‑negotiable security requirements, rough infra + procurement timeline, and acceptance criteria. I'll own scoping.
lee_eng_infra: Air‑gapped is heavy. We need to confirm: 1) hardware spec (GPUs + NVMe) 2) compatibility with our on‑prem install (k8s or bare metal) 3) whether they can host control plane or want our private control plane in their VPC.
sam_sre: Also need runbooks for offline upgrades and rollback. Canary strategy has to be local only. Metrics export will be via flat files or push to internal SIEM — confirm.
oliver_security: Security checklist: HSM integration (PKCS#11), FIPS certs, SAML IdP metadata, encrypted audit logs, EDR support, and supply chain attestation for any third‑party drivers. We'll need a security questionnaire and to schedule a design review.
anya_cust_success: Customer success note: Kumu has strict SLA expectations — they quoted 99.95% p99 latency < 300ms for chat flows. We should present realistic SLOs for on‑prem.
vivian_se: From product side, we need to list minimal feature set: model version pinning, offline model artifact install, KV cache persistence, and ability to roll back to prior model without external downloads. Also licensing key handshake for entitlements.
jordan_sales: Procurement note: customer has internal purchasing windows. If we miss the current quarter procurement approval, next slot is 10 weeks later. So 12 weeks total is tight but doable if dependencies parallelize.
maria_pm: Drafting a triage checklist now. High priority items: (A) Security review (oliver) (B) Infra feasibility + hardware lead time (lee) (C) SE install plan + test harness (vivian) (D) Legal/DPA (assigned to partnerships/legal but need to loop in) (E) Pricing + SOW draft (revenue).
lee_eng_infra: Hardware lead times: A100/RTX options vary; if customer insists on specific HW we should add 6–8 week procurement delay. We can offer two paths: (1) customer-supplied hardware (fast) or (2) Redwood-provisioned validated appliance (longer).
oliver_security: I'll start a security intake form this week. Requesting their network diagram and list of allowed external update endpoints. Also need to confirm KMS vendor for HSM integration.
vivian_se: I'll prepare an on‑prem quickstart + test harness (small loadgen, perf tests, and acceptance script). Acceptance criteria proposal: deployable offline, can serve baseline model at p95 latency < 250ms with target QPS 8, and can run a full rolling upgrade with zero lost requests on canary.
maria_pm: Draft acceptance criteria accepted as starting point. Next: assign owners + due dates. I propose ship a feasibility memo in 5 business days.
jordan_sales: Customers wants a date to present to their execs by next Tue (7 days). Can we make memo by then?
lee_eng_infra: 7 days is tight but we can produce a 'feasibility summary' with known blockers and options. I'll start a quick inventory of dependencies: networking (peering vs physical links), KMS/HSM, hardware procurement, on‑prem ops SLA, and control plane model.
sam_sre: Also add backup/restore flow and offline log export to the dependencies list.
anya_cust_success: I'll prep a customer readiness checklist for onboarding ops — helps avoid surprises during install.
maria_pm: Action items: lee — infra feasibility summary (due +3 days), oliver — security intake (due +4), vivian — test harness outline (due +5), legal — DPA template request (I'll ping legal), jordan — confirm procurement window with Kumu (due +1). I'll collect and produce the triage memo by next Tue.
jordan_sales: Thanks. I'll loop Kumu and set expectation for a feasibility summary next week.
deploy-bot: Note: created task #INTAKE-483 in Product intake board assigned to maria_pm.
maria_pm: Added — will sync Thurs 11am to review draft. If any blockers surface before then, flag in this thread. :thumbsup:
vivian_se: One more — add rollback acceptance test: ability to switch traffic to a previous model artifact within 10 minutes.
maria_pm: Noted. Closing initial triage. We'll include cost delta for customer‑supplied vs Redwood‑provisioned hardware in the memo.
jordan_sales: Appreciate it. Keeping exec ask warm.
anya_cust_success: I'll prepare a short onboarding plan to attach to the memo.
lee_eng_infra: Will include bridge plan if they want hybrid (initial VPC + eventual air‑gap).
